title: ADmod: code, frozen protocol, results and trained models for amyloid-PET forecasting under simulated measurement error and distribution shift
description: Code, frozen evaluation protocol with its git history, result files, training logs and the 35 trained checkpoints for the article "ADmod: A Temporally Conditioned 3D Encoder-Decoder for Amyloid-PET Forecasting Under Simulated Measurement Error and Distribution Shift" (submitted to IEEE Access). All data are synthetic and are regenerated from the generator seeds in protocol/protocol.json; the confirmatory cohorts are checked against the content digests in protocol/CONFIRM_COHORT_DIGESTS.txt. No human data are included.
